title: Implement and maintain secure environments for software development
reason: The environments are separated and protected (PO.5.1): development runs in an isolated, ephemeral cloud container per session, set up only by scripts/cloud/setup.sh from pinned, checksummed tools (cloud test) and checked by scripts/cloud/preflight, with no production credential in it (AGENTS.md: the site's tokens and database URLs are never sent to a cloud agent, and no session reads a credential file); the build and the gate run on GitHub Actions (CHK-tower-gate); production is reached only by the deploy a merge rings, and the production guard refuses a production entrypoint run anywhere else. The endpoint itself (PO.5.2) is the provider's sandbox, behind its network allowlist.
